education.title: Education
education.description: My background is a bridge between business logic and software engineering. Through my studies in Systems, Networks, and Web Development, I learned to build and deploy robust applications. Now, with a Degree in Economics, I integrate statistical analysis, econometrics, and mathematical optimization to interpret complex data, assess business viability, and develop technological solutions aimed at maximizing profits and optimizing costs.

eco.title: Degree in Economics
eco.desc: Analytical approach in microeconomics, macroeconomics, and business viability. Application of econometric, mathematical, and statistical models to interpret data, predict scenarios, optimize costs, and maximize profits with solid foundations.
eco.h1: Data analysis and interpretation for business decision-making
eco.h2: Mathematical optimization of costs and profits (Micro/Macroeconomics)
eco.h3: Econometrics: statistical modeling for theory validation and prediction

daw.title: Higher Technician in Web Application Development (DAW)
daw.desc: Technical specialization in software architecture, creation, and deployment. Development of complete cross-platform solutions, integrating both server-side logic and interactive user interfaces.
daw.h1: Development and deployment of Full-Stack applications
daw.h2: Creation of RESTful APIs and management of relational and NoSQL databases

smr.title: Technician in Microcomputer Systems and Networks (SMR)
smr.desc: Solid foundation in infrastructure and hardware. Administration of operating environments, local network structuring, and security fundamentals to maintain system continuity.
smr.h1: Installation, configuration, and administration of Linux (Ubuntu) and macOS environments
smr.h2: Design, configuration, and maintenance of local area networks (LAN)
smr.h3: Hardware management and preventive technical support

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.mapfont_desc: Mobile application deployed on the Google Play Store for mapping and font management. Handled complete deployment lifecycle including asset bundling and signing.

projects.dataapi_desc: High-performance data simulation engine exposed as a public REST API. Built to efficiently generate, test, and model complex data structures.
